lane: Local Windows CPU streaming-substrate gate (host FRODO, NVMe scratch under %TEMP%)

metricNaming: decode tok/s below is the merged-decode gather-step rate on a synthetic fixture (sequence-tokens produced per second by DecodeBatch union gathering). It is not end-to-end token generation for any flagship model.

arms.harness: LAIR engine DecodeBatch union gather over unbuffered FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING expert-role reads (no residency tier)
LAIR engine DecodeBatch union gather over RamHotExpertTier (capacity/cost hot expert copies + cold whole-role streaming reads)
LAIR engine DecodeBatch union gather over RamHotExpertTier at a budget that admits the whole expert footprint (capacity ceiling not binding)

sameRunPrefetchOnlyGatherArm.note: This run's streaming baseline was noisy (storage contention variance); the hot-arm and residency tallies stand on their own.

arms.harness: Control: historical OS-cached GgufMmapWeightSource mapping with the same ceiling-budget residency arm — reproduces the prior 'correct hit-rate, no tok/s win' posture

sameRunPrefetchOnlyGatherArm.note: OS-cached pages are not attributable per resolution on this substrate — that is exactly why the prior gate attempts saw no win.

streamSubstrateActualStreamedBytesPerTok.note: Streaming amplification is roleBytes/slabBytes = 12x because the loader has no per-slab staging: each cold slab resolution materializes its whole stacked role tensor. Residency removes that traffic for resident experts (ceiling budget removed it entirely).

evidenceSummary: Streaming substrate, half budget (quota 21 MiB, effective 18.6 MiB after KV reserve): +72.1% gather-step tok/s vs prefetch-only at 45.8% hit rate; streamed traffic fell from 32.6 GiB to 17.7 GiB per arm's timed reps.

Streaming substrate, ceiling budget (quota 42 MiB admits all 24 expert units): 100% hits, zero streamed bytes in timed reps, 344.9 tok/s vs the same run's streaming prefetch-only gather at 6.5-17.3 tok/s.

OS-cached mmap control with identical residency accounting (24/24 hot units, 864 MiB saved estimate): -10.2% tok/s — confirms the prior null result was a substrate artifact: cached pages leave no expensive read for residency to save.
caveats: Synthetic qwen2moe fixture proves mechanism and substrate behavior, not Flash-Next flagship throughput.
Windows NVMe streaming lane carries storage-read behavior but not Xeon NUMA/LLC fidelity; no perf counters were available on either lane (Xeon: perf absent, perf_event_paranoid=4).

Tier promotion/demotion tallies read 0 in the reported window by harness design (ResetAnswerTallies zeroes cumulative counters before the untimed tally replay); promotions stream whole role tensors and appear inside each arm's timed streamed totals when they land there.
